name: importprobe
description: Catch what your AI coding agent made up: packages that don't exist on npm, exports a package never had, methods that aren't there (even in chains like z.string().emailAddress()), APIs removed in your version, and dependencies missing from package.json. Verifies against the real package — without installing it. CLI, Claude Code hook and MCP server.

scripts.demo:setup: cd test/fixtures/ai-app && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../real-app && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

author: Kaan Kaya (https://github.com/KaanKaya17)
